HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #17
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Internal conflicts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Internal conflicts in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Internal conflicts in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Internal conflicts in Africa.
   D. Explain Internal conflicts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about French Revolutions is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   D. Skip evidence when discussing Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya.

8. Which statement about Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century.
   C. Say Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century as rumours only.

9. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Destroying road signs

   A. Explain National Security with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say National Security never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat National Security as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing National Security.

13. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Hide all money underground

14. Which statement about Colonial Administration in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   D. Treat Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.

16. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Name the president
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Measure rainfall only
